entry.summary: A Halifax sighting describes a lead-coloured barque-rigged cruiser breaking off pursuit under sail.

entry.title: 1921: North Bay to Winnipeg: a three-key rotating cipher broken blind

entry.title: 1923: "Please wire me code you use": a baffled publisher in Halifax
entry.summary: The Halifax Herald publisher could not read Meighen's reply; Slater −63 shows him deferring to "Zornwhite."
